experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hike
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route that winds through the most spectacular highlights of Torres del Paine National Park. The trail covers approximately 80km and passes through Valle del Francés, Grey Glacier, and the base of the iconic Torres towers. Book refugios or campsites in advance as spots fill up quickly during peak season.
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Central Circuit

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Wake before dawn and hike 4-5 hours to the iconic viewpoint at the base of the three granite towers. Witnessing the first light of sunrise paint the towers in shades of gold and pink is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The round trip is approximately 18km with significant elevation gain, requiring good fitness and proper gear.
experiences.location: Sector Las Torres, Eastern Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition
experiences.description: Paddle through the icy turquoise waters of Lago Grey surrounded by floating icebergs calved from the massive Grey Glacier. A guided kayaking tour brings you up close to the glacier face, offering a unique perspective that trekkers on foot cannot access. Guides provide all equipment including dry suits and safety gear for this unforgettable adventure.
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Western Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Patagonian Wildlife Safari & Pampas Walk
experiences.description: Explore the open pampas and lakeside trails of the park's eastern sector on a guided nature walk focused on Patagonian wildlife. Spot guanacos, Andean condors, flamingos, rheas, and the elusive puma in their natural habitat. A knowledgeable naturalist guide explains the unique Patagonian ecosystem, flora, and fauna throughout the experience.
experiences.location: Laguna Amarga & Pampas, Eastern Entrance Zone

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Full-Day Trek
experiences.description: Hike deep into the dramatic Valle del Francés, a glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers and towering granite walls. The trail leads to Mirador Británico, one of the most breathtaking panoramic viewpoints in all of Patagonia, offering 360-degree views of peaks including Paine Grande, Cuernos del Paine, and Cerro Cota 2000. Listen for the thunderous crack of calving ice throughout the day.
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Central Torres del Paine
